purpose: The fixed set for warm full-rewrite latency (spec EVAL06; docs/evaluation-protocol.md, stage 3). Fixed and pinned by sha256 in scripts/stage3.py before any candidate ran on it; a changed byte is a new set.
content: Synthetic text written for this set: invented requests with no real person's data. Places, products and programs named are public and generic.
input_tokens: Each message is one user turn with one text. Its input tokens are the tokens of the user message the daemon sends the rewriter, {"texts":[<text>]} as Go's json.Marshal writes it, counted with the candidate's own tokenizer without special tokens. Every message is at most 512; the kit counts them again with each candidate's tokenizer before any call.
expected_output: expected_output_bytes is the length a neutral rewrite should have, declared before any model ran: the message's UTF-8 bytes times 0.6 for a chatty message (filler, greetings, hedges to drop), 0.9 for a plain one, and 1.0 for a literal one (code, data or commands copied verbatim), rounded to a whole byte.
